details.question: What is the minimum length for a password?
details.answer: Passwords must have at least 14 characters [1].

details.question: When do I need multi-factor authentication?
details.answer: Multi‑factor authentication is mandatory for remote access through VPN, for email and collaboration tools when used from outside the company network, for all administrator accounts, and for all cloud services that hold company data【1】.

details.question: How quickly do critical vulnerabilities have to be patched?
details.answer: Critical vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.0 and higher) must be patched within 14 days of release [1]. If a vulnerability is known to be actively exploited, the update must be installed within 72 hours [1].
citations: IS-01_Information_Security_Policy.pdf p.2 6. Patch and Vulnerability Management

details.question: What is the deadline for a vulnerability that is actively exploited?
details.answer: The update for a vulnerability that is known to be actively exploited must be installed within 72 hours [1].
citations: IS-01_Information_Security_Policy.pdf p.2 6. Patch and Vulnerability Management

details.question: How often are privileged accounts reviewed?
details.answer: Privileged accounts are reviewed every 3 months [1].

details.question: Am I allowed to use a USB stick?
details.answer:
USB mass storage devices are blocked by default [1].  
You may use a USB stick only if you obtain a CISO‑approved exception for a specific business need, which can be granted for a maximum of 90 days [1].

details.question: After how many minutes does my screen lock?
details.answer: The screen locks automatically after 10 minutes of inactivity [1].

details.question: What happens if a production machine cannot be patched?
details.answer: If a production machine cannot be patched, it must have documented compensating controls and an exception approved by the CISO, with the exception reviewed every 6 months [1].
citations: IS-01_Information_Security_Policy.pdf p.2 6. Patch and Vulnerability Management

details.question: How often do we test restoring from backup?
details.answer: Restoring from backup is tested every quarter [1].

details.question: Can I paste customer personal data into an AI chatbot?
details.answer: No – you must not paste customer personal data into a generative AI tool unless a data‑protection impact assessment has specifically approved that use case [2].
citations: IT-04_Acceptable_Use_and_Generative_AI_Policy.pdf p.1 5. Data Classification and AI Tools

details.question: Which generative AI tools am I allowed to use with company information?
details.answer: You may only use the generative AI tools that appear on the approved AI tools list on the intranet — currently the enterprise chat assistant (covered by a data processing agreement) and the code assistant for software developers [1]. Public, free AI tools can be used only with information that is already public [1].

details.question: Do images created with AI need to be labelled when we publish them?
details.answer: Yes, any AI‑generated images that are published externally must be labelled as AI‑generated [1].

details.question: Who has to approve a new AI use case?
details.answer: The AI Governance Board must approve any new AI use case before development begins【1】【2】

details.question: How long does the AI Governance Board take to decide on a request?
details.answer: The AI Governance Board decides on complete requests within 20 working days【1】.

details.question: Can I set up automatic forwarding of my work email to my private account?
details.answer: No, automatic forwarding of your work email to a private account is prohibited. [1]

details.question: How long do we keep the data of rejected job applicants?
details.answer: Data of unsuccessful applicants is deleted 6 months after the end of the application process, unless the applicant agreed to be kept in the talent pool, in which case it is retained for up to 2 years [1].

details.question: How long must invoices be retained?
details.answer: Invoices and accounting vouchers must be retained for 8 years [1].

details.question: How long is CCTV footage kept?
details.answer: CCTV recordings at the plant gates are retained for 72 hours, unless they are required for an incident investigation [1].

details.question: Within what time do I have to report a personal data breach internally?
details.answer: You must report a suspected personal data breach to the DPO and IT Security immediately and no later than 24 hours after discovery【1】.

details.question: How much time do we have to answer a data subject access request?
details.answer: The company must provide its answer to a data subject access request within one month of receipt [1].

details.question: What should I do if I think my laptop has ransomware?
details.answer:
If you suspect ransomware, disconnect the laptop from the network by unplugging the cable and turning off Wi‑Fi. [1]  
Do not shut the computer down, as that can destroy evidence. [1]  
Immediately call the security hotline (extension 4444) or use the security mailbox to report the incident. [1][4]  
If you clicked a link or entered your password, report it right away and change your password. [1]
citations: IS-07_Incident_Response_Procedure.pdf p.1 4. First Steps for Employees

details.question: How quickly do I have to report a lost laptop?
details.answer: You must report a lost laptop within 1 hour of noticing the loss【1】.

details.question: What is the response time for a P1 critical incident?
details.answer: A P1 critical incident must be acknowledged within 15 minutes, 24 hours a day. [1]
citations: IS-07_Incident_Response_Procedure.pdf p.1 3. Severity Levels and Response Times

details.question: When does the post-incident review take place?
details.answer: A post‑incident review is held within 5 working days after a P1 or P2 incident is closed【1】.

details.question: When must we send an early warning to the BSI under NIS2?
details.answer: An early warning to the BSI must be sent within 24 hours of becoming aware of the incident under the NIS2 directive [1].
citations: IS-07_Incident_Response_Procedure.pdf p.1 6. Communication and Reporting Obligations
